Class Endpoint

  • Constructor Details

    • Endpoint

      public Endpoint(Transport transport, boolean creator)
      The side that created the channel allocates odd stream ids, the answerer even. The read loop starts on start() — after any dispatcher is installed, so an early HEADERS can never race dispatcher setup.
